{07 13 00}Bugs are so adorable! I
just want to hug them
to pieces!
{07 16 00}But then there'd be bug
juice all over the place!{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 07 00}Ewwwwwwww!

{07 17 00}It's kinda embarrassing, but
my room is totally packed
with bugs right now!
{07 14 00}You aren't totally grossed
out by that, are you,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

{07 14 00}Let's get together
sometime and kick back and
watch some bugs!
